fields.description: Manarat Living III is the final phase of Aldar’s Manarat Living collection in Saadiyat Cultural District. Studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments are paired with shared creative spaces, including a podcast studio, gaming room and rooftop cinema.

research.community: Saadiyat Cultural District · Manarat Living III
overview: The official brochure takes a more expressive approach to shared interiors, with exposed concrete, coloured seating and dedicated spaces for recording, games and work. This is an apartment community within the cultural district, rather than a private beachfront villa development.
research.locationNote: Aldar places Manarat Living III in Saadiyat Island’s Cultural District. The building’s orientation and specific floor determine its outlook; proximity to cultural destinations does not guarantee unobstructed landmark views.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s FAQ records AED 1.05m, while its headline currently shows approximately AED 1.1m. The earlier figure is a launch reference, not a live unit quotation. Aldar announced the original 400-home release sold out in January 2025; any current resale or re-release needs checking.
research.paymentNote: The reported plan is 10% at launch, 55% during construction and 35% on handover. The portal mentions five construction instalments without exposing a complete dated schedule. Confirm the contractual dates and outstanding balance.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder lists April 2028, within Q2. This remains an estimate; obtain the latest unit-specific developer completion and possession dates before committing.
